notes.subject: נפשם
notes.rationale: נפש is throat/breath/life-force; Tok Pisin 'bel' (seat of desire) chosen over 'sol wara'/'soul'

notes.subject: רזון
notes.rationale: hapax 'thinness/leanness': literal wasting (of body), or 'failure/disappointment' of appetite — KJV 'leanness', BSB 'wasting disease'

translation: Na em i givim olgeta long ol olsem ol i askim long en, tasol em i salim narapela samting i go insait — tupela i lusim strong — long bel bilong ol.
